population.primary: full_card: every supplied historical card row
population.secondary: final_starters: retrospectively restrict to finished, disqualified, or did_not_finish then recompute the complete joint distribution
population.small_field_note: Target A always means top three. It is not converted to top two in fields of seven or fewer.
population.cancellation_note: Full-card and final-starter metrics answer different information-time questions; final-starter probabilities are newly normalized on that subset.

targets.A: A_slot_inclusion_probability: per-horse probability of occupying one of exactly three podium slots; probabilities sum to 3 per race. On non-boundary-tie races this equals the ordinary official top3 event probability.
targets.B: normalized distribution over every unordered three-horse set
targets.C: normalized distribution over every ordered first/second/third triple

ties.compatible_sets: At a tied boundary, all three-horse sets consistent with official ranks are correct; the target distribution is uniform over compatible sets.
ties.compatible_orders: All permutations within an official tie group and all boundary-compatible choices are correct; the target distribution is uniform over compatible ordered triples.
ties.A_boundary_target: Marginal inclusion under the uniform compatible-set target; a tied third-place boundary may therefore have fractional labels. The binary official rank<=3 event label is retained separately and is not mislabeled as the three-slot probability.
ties.log_loss: negative log of total predicted probability assigned to all compatible answers
ties.brier: squared error against the uniform compatible-answer distribution; A boundary-tie Brier is also reported separately

training.top3_objective: LightGBM cross_entropy with fractional A boundary labels and race-balanced row weights
training.rank_objective: LightGBM lambdarank relevance 3/2/1/0 with equal relevance for official ties
training.position_objective: three LightGBM cross_entropy models for compatible position-1/2/3 fractional labels
training.calibration: Separate scalar joint-distribution temperatures for A, B, and C per candidate and venue: A minimizes race-mean binary CE on non-boundary races, B minimizes compatible-set NLL, C minimizes compatible-order NLL. Each target-specific temperature defines its own fully coherent joint distribution; probabilities calibrated or selected for different targets are never combined into one synthetic distribution. GLOBAL is the fallback below 100 venue races.

joint_probability_contract.top3_set_energy: softmax over scores of every unordered triple; never an unnormalized product of independent A probabilities; order within a set uses the frozen win72 PL conditional distribution
joint_probability_contract.rank_plackett_luce: one coherent PL distribution over all distinct ordered triples; B and A are exact marginals
joint_probability_contract.position_order_energy: softmax over all distinct ordered triples using position-specific logits; B and A are exact marginals

selection.primary_metric: full-card loss: A uses the mean of per-race mean binary CE on non-boundary races; B/C use compatible-answer race NLL
selection.rule: Against win72_pl, improve target log loss in at least 3 of 4 development years in both SEOUL and BUSAN; compare qualifying candidates with win72_pl itself and choose minimum pooled 2021-2024 log loss then Brier. Thus a qualifying candidate with a large loss in the fourth year cannot displace a better pooled baseline. If none qualify, retain win72_pl.

diagnostics.A_threshold_primary_scope: one highest A probability horse per race; all-entry threshold counts are supplemental and labeled separately
diagnostics.confidence: 95% Wilson binomial interval and 1000-repetition race-date cluster bootstrap
diagnostics.warning: Coverage, sample size, mean predicted probability, and actual hit rate are all reported; a high forecast probability is not itself evidence of a high realized hit rate.

outputs.row_predictions: predictions/{year}_{candidate}_{cohort}_A.parquet: entry keys, A_slot_inclusion_probability, official_top3_event_label, target_slot_inclusion, boundary_tie
outputs.combination_predictions: predictions/{year}_{candidate}_{cohort}_joint_top10.parquet: target A/B/C, rank, predicted key/probability, actual compatible keys, exact hit, horse overlap, correct-position count, and exact total-mass checks
outputs.metrics: target/cohort/year/venue log loss, Brier, top-1 hit, calibration and high-probability diagnostics
outputs.models: portable LightGBM model.txt plus metadata.json and train-only category vocabulary
